title: Sigma i detection as code
summary: Pisanje Sigma pravila (logsource, detection, modifikatori, uslovi, korelacije), konverzija sa sigma-cli u Splunk, Elastic i KQL uz pipeline, testiranje Zircoliteom i životni ciklus detekcije kao koda.
summary_en: Writing Sigma rules (logsource, detection, modifiers, conditions, correlations), converting with sigma-cli to Splunk, Elastic and KQL using pipelines, testing with Zircolite, and the detection-as-code lifecycle.
